name: npm-script-lens
description: See what install scripts actually do — inline risk in package.json for npm/pnpm/yarn/bun allowlists.

commands.title: npm-script-lens: Sync allowlist with the lockfile

npmScriptLens.command.description: Command used to run the npm-script-lens CLI (e.g. 'npx npm-script-lens' or an absolute path).

npmScriptLens.trust.description: Enable OSV malware + publisher-trust enrichment when auditing from the editor (slower; hits the network).

walkthroughs.title: Get started with npm-script-lens
walkthroughs.description: See what your dependencies' install scripts do, then lock down the allowlist.

steps.title: Audit your install scripts
steps.description:
Open a package.json and risky install scripts are flagged inline — or run it now.
[Audit install scripts](command:npmScriptLens.audit)

steps.title: Generate your allowlist
steps.description:
Auto-approve the packages behavioral analysis found safe; hold the rest for review — in your package manager's native format.
[Generate allowlist](command:npmScriptLens.allowWrite)

steps.title: Enforce it in CI
steps.description:
Scaffold a policy + CI workflow so the allowlist stays enforced on every PR.
[Review pending approvals](command:npmScriptLens.review)
